fields.equipment: The name of the industrial asset or piece of equipment.
fields.tag: The unique identifier or asset tag for the equipment.
fields.parameter: The specific measurement or variable being monitored.
fields.unit: The unit of measure for the parameter.
fields.ll: The low-low or lower bound limit value.
fields.hl: The high-high or upper bound limit value.
fields.action_remarks: Narrative description of the trigger condition and the resulting action.
fields.requirement: A mandatory rule or obligation that must be met.
fields.condition: The specific state or trigger that activates a rule or action.
fields.action: The required response or automatic result triggered by a condition.
fields.confined_space: Identification of equipment designated as a confined space.
fields.biogas_quality_interlock: Specific conditions related to biogas quality that trigger an interlock.
fields.digester_agitator: The tag or identifier for the digester agitator.
fields.alarm: The description or name of the alarm event.
fields.alarm_designation: The criticality or priority level of the alarm.
fields.flare_area_exclusion: Identification of equipment within the flare exclusion area.
fields.alarms: A list or group of alarms associated with the record.
fields.sensor: The identifier of the sensor providing the measurement.
fields.probes: The identifiers of the probes providing the measurement.
fields.notification: The text of the notification logged by the system.
fields.reminder: The text of the reminder issued by the system.
fields.system: The specific subsystem involved in the operation.
fields.frequency: The interval at which a task must be performed.
fields.limits: The set of acceptable ranges for multiple parameters.
fields.location: The physical location where the rule or task applies.
fields.exclusion_zone: The defined boundary of a restricted area.
fields.personnel_entry: The rules governing whether personnel may enter an area.

categories.OperatingLimit: Limits defined for normal or safe operation.
categories.AutomaticReaction: Actions triggered automatically by the control system.
categories.RecurringDuty: Tasks that must be performed on a regular schedule.
categories.StartInterlock: Conditions that must be met before equipment can start.
categories.AccessRequirement: Rules governing entry into specific areas or equipment.
categories.SafetyLimit: Limits defined specifically for safety thresholds.
